description: Complete STAR with a measurable result
question: Tell me about a time you fixed a problem in production under pressure.
transcript: Last Black Friday our checkout error rate jumped from under half a percent to four percent about an hour after we opened. I was the on-call frontend engineer, so it was on me to find the cause while the team kept the store up. I pulled the error logs, saw that every failure was a double submit on the payment step, and traced it to a retry we had added the week before that fired before the first request timed out. I put the retry behind a feature flag, turned it off, and shipped a fix that disabled the button while a request was in flight. Errors were back under half a percent in twenty minutes, and afterwards I added an alert on checkout error rate so we'd catch it in five minutes instead of an hour.

question: Describe a time you had to lead without formal authority.
transcript: We had three teams each building their own date picker, and the designs were drifting apart. I wasn't anyone's manager, but I offered to own a shared component. I set up a short call with one person from each team, collected what each version needed, wrote a small RFC and built the first version with the props everyone agreed on. Then I paired with each team to migrate their first screen.

description: Technical answer with context, problem, solution and trade-offs
question: How would you find and fix a slow page load in a React app?
transcript: First I'd measure instead of guessing: a Lighthouse run and the Performance panel on a throttled connection, plus field data if we have it, to see whether the problem is the network, the bundle or rendering. On a dashboard I worked on, the main bundle was over two megabytes because a charting library and moment were imported on the first route. I split the routes with lazy imports, replaced moment with date-fns and moved the chart behind a dynamic import. The trade-off is a small delay when you first open a chart, so we prefetch it on hover. Largest contentful paint went from about four seconds to one point six on a mid-range phone.

question: Me conte sobre uma vez em que você teve que aprender algo novo rápido.
transcript: Entrei num time que usava Vue e eu só conhecia React. Tinha duas semanas pra assumir uma feature de pagamentos. Então eu li a documentação oficial à noite, refiz uma tela pequena do produto num projeto separado e pedi pra fazer pair com a pessoa mais experiente do time nas primeiras tarefas. Na segunda semana eu já estava abrindo PRs sozinho e a feature saiu no prazo.

question: Tell me about a time you improved a process on your team.
transcript: Our code reviews were taking forever. I suggested we split big pull requests into smaller ones and add a checklist to the template. People liked it and reviews got faster.
